en.插件无法连接当前 Harness，请检查宿主是否已就绪。: The plugin could not connect to this ClawMaster. Check whether the host is ready.
en.Harness 健康检查超时。请确认 dsh web 未阻塞。: The ClawMaster health check timed out. Check whether the host is responsive.
en.Harness 健康检查需要身份认证。请检查代理、网关或自定义鉴权配置。: The ClawMaster health check requires authentication. Check proxy, gateway or custom authentication settings.
en.本机 Harness 请求被代理要求认证。请让回环地址绕过代理，并检查 NO_P: The proxy requires authentication for the local ClawMaster request. Bypass the proxy for loopback addresses and check NO_PROXY.
en.Harness 异常拒绝了回环地址的健康检查。请检查 HTTP 代理、Harne: ClawMaster rejected a loopback health check. Check the HTTP proxy and the running ClawMaster build.
en.Harness 的 Host 信任检查拒绝了非回环地址请求。请检查 harnes: ClawMaster rejected the non-loopback Host. Check harnessBaseUrl and trustedHosts.
en.健康检查收到了非 Harness 标准的 403 拒绝响应。请检查代理或网关配置: The health check received a non-standard HTTP 403 response. Check proxy or gateway settings.
en.找不到 Harness 健康检查接口。请确认 Harness 与插件版本兼容。: The ClawMaster health check endpoint was not found. Check ClawMaster and plugin compatibility.
en.Harness 健康检查返回服务错误。请查看 DSH 日志。: The ClawMaster health check returned a service error. Check the DSH logs.
en.Harness 返回了无法识别的响应。请确认 Harness 与插件版本兼容。: ClawMaster returned an unrecognized response. Check ClawMaster and plugin compatibility.
en.Harness 拒绝了健康检查请求。请查看 DSH 日志。: ClawMaster rejected the health check. Check the DSH logs.
en.Harness 健康检查发生未知错误。请查看 DSH 日志。: The ClawMaster health check failed with an unknown error. Check the DSH logs.
en.请确认当前 DSH 宿主已就绪，并检查 Harness 与插件实际运行版本及宿主: Check that this DSH host is ready, and check the running ClawMaster and plugin versions and the host logs.
en.请在运行当前 Harness 的同一环境执行，保持 DSH_HOME 一致，完成: Run this in the same environment as the current ClawMaster, with the same DSH_HOME, then restart manually.
en.无法确认当前 profile，请在对应的 Harness 环境中手动更新。: The current profile could not be identified. Update manually in the corresponding ClawMaster environment.
en.新版本已安装，请在方便时手动重启当前 Harness 或 Desktop。: The new version is installed. Manually restart this ClawMaster or Desktop when convenient.
en.页面版本与运行版本不同，请手动刷新页面；若仍不一致，请手动重启 Harness: The page and running versions differ. Refresh the page manually; if they still differ, manually restart ClawMaster or Desktop.
en.本机主动连接公网 Office；Harness 不开放端口。协议 Hook 固定: This machine connects outward to the public Office; ClawMaster exposes no port. Protocol hooks:
en.Office Hook 尚未部署时，配置会安全保存并自动重试；出现 HTTP 4: Configuration is saved and retried while Office hooks are unavailable; HTTP 404 means the protocol endpoint is pending, not a ClawMaster failure.
en.扫一次码，就能在微信里使用 Harness: Scan once to use ClawMaster in WeChat
en.正在保存凭据并验证 Harness 与微信长轮询。: Saving credentials and verifying the WeChat connection.
en.微信已授权，但插件无法连接本机 Harness。请检查 dsh web 地址和端: WeChat was authorized, but the plugin could not connect to the local ClawMaster. Check the dsh web address and port.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查超时。请确认 dsh web 未阻塞。: WeChat was authorized, but the ClawMaster health check timed out. Confirm that dsh web is not blocked.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 拒绝了本机健康检查。请检查 Host 信任配置。: WeChat was authorized, but ClawMaster denied the local health check. Check the Host trust configuration.
en.微信已授权，但找不到 Harness 健康检查接口。请确认 Harness 与插: WeChat was authorized, but the ClawMaster health endpoint was not found. Confirm that ClawMaster and the plugin are compatible.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查返回服务错误。请查看 dsh web 日: WeChat was authorized, but the ClawMaster health check returned a service error. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 返回了无法识别的响应。请确认 Harness 与: WeChat was authorized, but ClawMaster returned an unrecognized response. Confirm that ClawMaster and the plugin are compatible.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 拒绝了健康检查请求。请查看 dsh web 日志: WeChat was authorized, but ClawMaster rejected the health-check request. Check the dsh web logs.
en.微信已授权，但 Harness 健康检查发生未知错误。请查看 dsh web 日: WeChat was authorized, but the ClawMaster health check failed unexpectedly. Check the dsh web logs.
en.二维码由腾讯微信 iLink 服务签发。用手机微信扫描并确认后，账号凭据会直接写: The QR code is issued by Tencent WeChat iLink. After you scan and confirm, account credentials are written directly to the ClawMaster and are never exposed to the browser.
en.授权由钉钉官方页面完成。扫码账号必须已加入一个企业/组织并有权创建机器人；创建成: Authorization is completed on DingTalk’s official page. The account must belong to an organization and be allowed to create bots. Credentials are written directly to the ClawMaster.
en.腾讯页面会创建或绑定一个 QQ 机器人，并把连接凭据安全交给本机 Harness: Tencent will create or connect a QQ bot and securely deliver its credentials to the local ClawMaster.
en.企业微信官方页面会创建一个智能机器人，并把连接凭据安全交给本机 Harness: WeCom will create an AI bot and securely deliver its credentials to the local ClawMaster.
en.从此 Harness 移除这个微信账号？: Remove this WeChat account from ClawMaster?
en.仅支持已经聊过、已建立当前会话且使用当前 Host Harness 的私聊目标: Only a known direct message with a current Session on this ClawMaster is supported
en.会话同步仅支持已经聊过、已建立当前会话且使用当前 Host Harness 的私: Session sync requires a known direct message with a current Session on this ClawMaster.
